event.text: I recommend having a Counsel clinician review your lipid results with you in this message thread; that's the right setting, with a same-day service-hours target. Interpreting cholesterol numbers depends on your personal risk factors, family history and other health conditions, so please share the actual report values. Separately, if you develop chest pain, pressure, breathlessness or new one-sided weakness or speech trouble, call 911 immediately.
